votes.motion: Commissioner Lisa Fowler motioned to approve the August 27, 2020 Minutes

Commissioner Squire motioned to approve the Planning Commission Meeting Schedule for 2021 with the following changes to the November 2021 and December 2021 meeting dates. November 4th instead of November 11th, November 18th instead of November 25th, and December 16th instead of December 23rd

Commissioner Player motioned to forward a negative recommendation to the City Council for the Rasmussen Family commercial rezone request as requested by One West Construction representing the Rasmussen Family Limited Partnership. Application TEXT MAP-1066-2020 based on the findings listed in the Staff Report dated November 3, 2020. 5

Application TEXTMAP-1074-2020 based on the findings listed in the Staff Report dated November 3, 2020

Application SUBD-1060-2020. Based on the findings and subject to the conditions listed in the Staff Report dated November 2, 2020
